mapper.sql: select r.record_id, r.inviter_id, inviter.user_name as inviter_user_name, r.invitee_id, invitee.user_name as invitee_user_name, r.action, r.amount, r.source_type, r.source_id, r.balance_after, r.frozen_until, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark from ai_invite_rebate_record r left join sys_user inviter on inviter.user_id = r.inviter_id left join sys_user invitee on invitee.user_id = r.invitee_id
mapper.insert: insert ignore into ai_invite_rebate_record (inviter_id, invitee_id, action, amount, source_type, source_id, frozen_until, create_time) values (#{inviterId}, #{inviteeId}, #{action}, #{amount}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{frozenUntil}, sysdate())
insert into ai_invite_rebate_record (inviter_id, invitee_id, action, amount, balance_after, create_time) values (#{inviterId}, null, #{action}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from ai_invite_rebate_record where inviter_id = #{inviterId} and action = '1' and frozen_until is not null and frozen_until <= now()
select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from ai_invite_rebate_record where inviter_id = #{inviterId} and invitee_id = #{inviteeId} and action = '1'
mapper.update: update ai_invite_rebate_record set frozen_until = null where inviter_id = #{inviterId} and action = '1' and frozen_until is not null and frozen_until <= now()
mapper.select: select a.invitee_id as user_id, u.user_name, u.email, coalesce(sum(a.amount), 0) as total_rebate, min(a.create_time) as create_time from ai_invite_rebate_record a left join sys_user u on u.user_id = a.invitee_id where a.inviter_id = #{inviterId} and a.action = '1' group by a.invitee_id, u.user_name, u.email order by create_time desc limit #{limit}
